content: The notice says the rockslide clears on the morning of day 5. It's currently day 3, 7:84. I need to wait until day 5 morning. Let me record this fact and wait.

args.lesson: In the Meadow, the rockslide at (11,4) blocks the only path to the Old Shrine chest at (11,1); the notice board says the repair crew clears it on the morning of day 5.
